svg.text: J48 ZIF-28 socket pin map — every device is head-aligned (chip pin 1 at ZIF pin 1)
20-pin parts use ZIF 1–10 and 19–28; 24-pin parts use ZIF 1–12 and 17–28; 28-pin parts fill the socket. GND and VCC are switched per size (Rev H).
serial clock, DIN/DOUT data, STR strobe
switched VCC_SKT (* = switch, see panel notes)
● chip pin present ○ socket contact unused
ZIF-28 pin map: each device's role at every ZIF pin, and the Rev H connection
1. Role names: EDIT = VPP pin in edit mode, PV = program/verify, STR = strobe, DIN/DOUT = serial data in/out, RA0–RA5 = row address. '–' = held low or undriven.

2. Signals the MCU reads (DOUT, TDO) land on MCU pins: ZIF 9, 15, 18, 19, 20 and 26. ZIF 6 (18V10 SCLK), 12–14 (26CV12 SCLK, DIN, STR) and 27 (PV, JTAG TCK) go through a 74HC595 and change only on a latch pulse.
3. GND and VCC are switched per chip size and all switches are off at reset: one GND switch (Q1, Q4 or Q5) and one VCC switch (Q6 or Q7) at a time. Never Q6 with Q7; never Q4 with a 28-pin part.
4. ZIF 1, 16, 22, 23 and (when Q6 is off) 28 have pull-downs; ZIF 21's pull-down is shared with the Q5 ground switch.
5. Chip pin for 24-pin parts: ZIF 1–12 = pins 1–12, ZIF 17–28 = pins 13–24. For 20-pin parts: ZIF 1–10 = pins 1–10, ZIF 19–28 = pins 11–20.
